items.title: Neko Cafe HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Meow! Welcome to the cutest cat café in town! An anime inspired skin pack with a variety of bright and pastel colored hair and clothing. Comes with chibi styled felines for customers to meet and kawaii employees to serve tea.

+ 15 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Modern Teens
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Teens are rocking their free world! Summer is here, Minecraft music is in the air, and teen friends are hanging out in the modern city. Parkouring through the city, going to the cinema, and even playing Minecraft with mods, they do have various activities. Will you become friends with them?

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Sad Cats
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Oh no, these cute cats are crying! Somehow they look even cuter when they're sad... how can we cheer them up?

- 8 adorable cat skins!
- Pick from many different breeds!

items.title: Retro
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Old school never went out of style and likely never will. So take part in the retro hype with these classic 80s themed skins.

items.title: Fusion
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Fusion is the end result of combining the most vivid of colors with the most eccentric of designs. Nothing of such a degree should exist in a rational world. It’s very presence is an enigma, pushing the bounds of what is possible. Yet here it is in all its glory, tempting fate.

-36 skins

items.title: Anime Life 2
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Your life revolves around anime, make it more obvious with these stylish themed skins.

-20 skins

items.title: Household
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Household appliances just came to life. Join them in their quest of exploring this new found sentience. Maybe take a stroll around the park or a swim in a pool… well, maybe not a pool. Whatever it may be, make the most of your new friends, after all robots have feelings too.

items.title: Anime Life
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Anime is more than your style, it is your life. Wear it with pride.

-20 skins

items.title: Hackers
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: These black hat hackers are tired of coding for virtuous reasons and have turned to the dark side. Will their moral compass bring them back to the light side before it is too late? After all, an anonymous identity is typically short-lived.

items.title: Villains
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Villainy is about to reach new heights with this supervillain squad afoot. They don’t take well to heroes. Where they come from the ends justify the means. Will you join them or put them in their place?
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Modern Hospital Life
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Roleplay in the immersive modern hospital and explore the city. Try a life as a doctor, paramedic, surgeon or nurse and rescue patients with a medical rescue helicopter, ambulance or wheelchair. Explore the hospital with friends and save lives!

+ Furnished immersive hospital and city
+ Many luxury cars & more
+ Multiplayer-friendly
+ Free skin

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Free the Scientists
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The scientists are stuck in their labs! Management have decided that it’s up to you to save them! Solve puzzles! Parkour through the labs! Free. The. Scientists!

- 15 Puzzle-Parkour levels!
- Rank system and collectible coffee mugs for added challenge!
- Single player.
- A fourth bullet point!

items.title: Mobs Teleport
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Be careful, it looks like a spell was unleashed on all the mobs!
They are now teleporting everywhere throughout the world!

+ The endermen won't feel special anymore!
+ All the mobs are teleporting, it sounds like a challenge for a brave warrior!
+ 2 skins included!

items.title: Lost Duckies
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
If you are lost, you can always find a home in the Lost Duckies family. Join the family because, in Lost Duckies, no duckies are left behind!

- 10 cool ducky skins!
+ 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion and Lostduckies!

items.title: Stylin Luxury Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Cool, stylish, luxurious and dazzling! Choose between one of these trendy skins and attracts everyone's attention!

- 10 stylin luxury teens skins!
- Perfect for roleplay or showing-off!
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Skyblock Spirals
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Lets start a new skyblock adventure on several spiral rings floating in the air. Can you explore all floating islands, find the villagers and defeat the Ender Dragon?

- Explore the different biomes on the spiral rings!
- A objective book with a lot of challenges!
- Cool adventure for you and your friends!
- By Pixelusion and Hylarion

items.title: Secret Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A million dollar mansion dream escape is yours today! Come on in and make it your own!

+ Tons of hidden rooms in your base!
+ Nether and end portal!
+ Food farm and garden!

items.title: HD Galaxy
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Be one with the stars! Role-play as one of the planets and explore the Minecraft universe!

+ Role-play ready!
+ 10 skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Ocean Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
We are now under the sea! Become an oceanic-style teen with this awesome skin pack!

+ 10 ocean-themed skins!
+ Roleplay ready!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Aliens Vs Machines
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
When life from beyond the galaxy comes, humanity will be prepared to defend itself. We have the technology. It will be a time of aliens versus machines!

- 20 roleplay skins!
- Futuristic attire inspired by anime and science fiction!

items.title: Gamer Mobs
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
You're a gamer! Wear your favorite gamer gear on your favorite Minecraft mobs! Put on comfy human clothes that are great for relaxing and playing your favorite games!

+ Modern attire
+ Great for roleplay
+ Perfect for teens
+ Cool and cute skins

items.title: Anime Masks
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These masks give your character a cool, unique style. Find your favorite color and style!

+ Modern skin designs
+ Perfect for teens
+ 1 free skin!

items.title: ONE BLOCK SKYBLOCK
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
ONE BLOCK SKYBLOCK is a new challenge!

Break one block to get more!

+ 2 one block maps

items.title: Magic Users
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: The mastery of the four elements, water, earth, fire, and air is what makes a mage. In hushed whispers, however, it’s said that some mages were able to bend the very reality of this realm to their will, and their power was only limited by their imagination! Test your limits, master the elements and create your own school of magic with the Magic Users skin pack!
